methods.label: Draw a perpendicular and prove its length
methods.explanation: When no common point is known, use the approach “draw a perpendicular and prove its length equals the radius”: Draw \(OD\perp l\), then prove \(OD=r\). Thus \(d=r\), so the line is tangent to the circle.
methods.levelReason: This is the Grade 9 tangency approach for a line without an already identified circle point.
